        from

            where business_date = date'2025-05-30'
            and instrument_group_name in ('Call money')
            and portfolio_group_code = 'CPPIB GROUP'
            group by business_date

            where business_date = date'2025-05-30'
            and instrument_type_name in ('Payable to DCM')
            and portfolio_group_code = 'CPPIB GROUP'
            group by business_date
        ) 
        cm2 on cm1.business_date = cm2.business_date
        left join
        (
            SELECT business_date, 'Call Money Interim - 3', sum(abor_total_market_value_pc) as MV_3
            from holdings.seed_holding
            where business_date = date'2025-05-30'
            and instrument_type_name in ('SBL Cash Collateral')
            and portfolio_group_code = 'CPPIB GROUP'
            group by business_date

WITH

        max(business_date) as end_date,
        date_add('day', -10, max(business_date)) as start_date
    from
        credit_investment_private_enriched_dev.ci_capital_pipeline
),
record_counts as (
    select
        publish_timestamp,
        business_date,
        count(*) as number_of_recs
    from 
        credit_investment_private_enriched_dev.ci_capital_pipeline
        join business_dates_range
            on business_date between start_date and end_date
    group by
        publish_timestamp,
        business_date
),
max_and_avg_counts_prev_10_days as (
    select
        avg(number_of_recs)+avg(number_of_recs)*0.2 as daily_max_rec_number,
        avg(number_of_recs) as daily_min_rec_number
    from 
        record_counts
        join business_dates_range
            on business_date >= start_date 
                and business_date <= end_date
)

SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"

	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'

SELECT aa.business_date,

                                aa.option_symbol,
                                aa.strike_price/1000.0 as strike,
                                aa.expiration_date,
                                aa.open_interest,
                                aa.call_put_flag,
                                aa.best_bid,

                                aa.vega, 
                                bb.close_price as SpotRef, 
                                aa.strike_price/1000.0/bb.close_price as Mny
                                from market.om_option_price aa
                                join market.om_security_price bb
                        on
                            bb.security_id=aa.security_id and bb.business_date = aa.business_date
                        where
                            aa.security_id = 110007
                            AND aa.business_date >= DATE '2025-05-30'
                            AND aa.business_date <= DATE '2025-05-30'
                            AND date_diff('day', aa.business_date, aa.expiration_date) > 5
                            AND aa.best_bid > 0
                            AND aa.best_ask > 0
                            AND aa.special_settlement_flag <> '1'
                            AND (

                                    WHEN aa.call_put_flag = 'C' THEN GREATEST(bb.close_price - aa.strike_price / 1000.0, 0)
                                    WHEN aa.call_put_flag = 'P' THEN GREATEST(aa.strike_price / 1000.0 - bb.close_price, 0)
                                END

SELECT

	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 02
		AND hour between 05 and 06
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-02 05:31:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 02
		AND hour between 09 and 10
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-02 09:30:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"
FROM (with scd_perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency

			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency

			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (

			select

				(

					and "level" = 0

				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365

			/* perf_top_down_monthly:

			 */

				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc

				, pnl_4yp_lc

			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name

		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level"

					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365

			/* perf_top_down_monthly:

			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc

				performance.perf_top_down_monthly

				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on

			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where

			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(

				or (

					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'

			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'

		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y

			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd

			select

				, pnl_4yp_rc

				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (

			/* perf_top_down_monthly:

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD

			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level"

				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc

				or (

	cross join unnest (

			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'

			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'

		/* VALUE */
		, array[

			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency

			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency

	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y

			, pnl_qtd_lc as pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_lc as pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		from
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )
			and "level" = 1
	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'

			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[

			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency

			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency

			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y

			 */

		left join (

				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */

					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365

			union all

				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc

	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */

		/* VALUE */

			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency

			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency

    oe.opportunity_deal_name,
    oe.cppib_group, --to map
    oe.collaboration_groups, --to map
    oe."deal_sub-type" as deal_type, --to map
    oe.status, oe.stage, --to map
    CASE WHEN oe.private_vs_public = 'Public' THEN true ELSE false END AS public_deal,

WITH

        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-05-31')
            AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
            AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_seg_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
            AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
            AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
            AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
            AND (
                        InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Power Generation')
                    AND investmentstructurelevel6 IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel7 IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                    AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
                     OR model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0','MPR1000279','MPR1000328','MPR1000200','MPAR100041')
                )
            AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency

                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf

        LEFT JOIN holdings.abor_aa_real_assets asset

		array[

			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_rc'

		/* VALUE */
		, array[

			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc

		, cast( format( '%1$tY%1$tm%1$td', business_date ) as int ) as business_date_int
		, date_format( business_date, '%Y-%m' ) as year_month
		--, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', calendar_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'

			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'

WITH
earliest_business_date_of_given_month AS (
    SELECT MIN(business_date) AS business_date
    FROM market_uat.refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
    WHERE rate_type_code = 'SR'
        AND MONTH(business_date) = MONTH(DATE('2025-06-02'))
        AND YEAR(business_date) = YEAR(DATE('2025-06-02'))
),
fx_rates_usd_to_cad AS (
    SELECT
        business_date business_date,
        (CASE WHEN (UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y') THEN (1 / mid_price) ELSE mid_price END) exchange_rate
    FROM
        market_uat.refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
    WHERE from_currency = 'USD'
        AND to_currency = 'CAD'
        AND mid_price IS NOT NULL
        AND mid_price <> 0
        AND rate_type_code = 'SR'
),
fx_rates_usd_to_local AS (
    SELECT
        business_date business_date,
        from_currency from_currency,
        to_currency to_currency,
        (CASE WHEN (UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y') THEN (1 / mid_price) ELSE mid_price END) exchange_rate
    FROM
        market_uat.refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
    WHERE from_currency = 'USD'
        AND mid_price IS NOT NULL
        AND mid_price <> 0
        AND rate_type_code = 'SR'
),
fx_rates_cad_to_local AS (
    SELECT
        usd_to_cl.business_date business_date,
        'CAD' from_currency,
        to_currency to_currency,
        ROUND((usd_to_cad.exchange_rate / usd_to_cl.exchange_rate), 8) exchange_rate
    FROM
        (fx_rates_usd_to_local usd_to_cl
        INNER JOIN fx_rates_usd_to_cad usd_to_cad ON (usd_to_cl.business_date = usd_to_cad.business_date))
    UNION
    SELECT
        business_date business_date,
        'CAD' from_currency,
        'USD' to_currency,
        exchange_rate exchange_rate
    FROM
        fx_rates_usd_to_cad usd_to_cad
)
SELECT
    business_date,
    from_currency,
    to_currency,
    exchange_rate
FROM fx_rates_cad_to_local
WHERE business_date = (SELECT business_date FROM earliest_business_date_of_given_month)

/* cppi::20ae676a8a70f57bfca75a635273fe01a042303264253039bca56f0d9fa6317b */
SELECT DISTINCT
                 h.business_date as business_date
               , s.inv_group level_1
               , s.inv_strategy level_2
               , s.inv_sub_strategy level_3
               , s.reporting_name reporting_name
               , s.asset_category instrumenttype
               , s.asset_type instrumentsubtype
               , i.issuer_name issuer
               , s.security_name sec_name
               , s.currency ccy
               , case 
                    when s.sentry_security_type IN ('termLoanFacility','delayedDrawLoanFacility','revolvingCreditFacility') Then loan_coup.colc_fixed_floating
                    else bond_coup.colc_fixed_floating
               end as  cpn_type   
               , case 
                    when s.sentry_security_type IN ('termLoanFacility','delayedDrawLoanFacility','revolvingCreditFacility') Then 
                            case when loan_coup.colc_fixed_floating = 'Fixed' Then cast(loan_coup.colc_fixed_rate as varchar(20))
                                 else loan_coup.colc_index_name || ' ' || replace(cast(cast(loan_coup.colc_spread*10000 as decimal(10,1)) as varchar),'.0','')  || 'bp'
                            end     
                    else case
                            when bond_coup.colc_fixed_floating = 'Fixed' Then cast(bond_coup.colc_fixed_rate as varchar(20))
                            when bond_coup.colc_fixed_floating = 'Floating' Then bond_coup.colc_index_name || ' ' || replace(cast(cast(bond_coup.colc_spread*10000 as decimal(10,1)) as varchar),'.0','') || 'bp'
                         end 
                end cpn_rate
               , case 
                    when s.sentry_security_type IN ('termLoanFacility','delayedDrawLoanFacility','revolvingCreditFacility') Then 
                        loan_coup.facility_maturity_date
                    else bond_coup.colc_maturity_date end maturity
               , c.country_code country --i.country_of_exposure country
               , i.region region
               , i.gics_sector sector
               , tt.translation rating
               , s.seniority rank
               , s.liquidity liquidity
               , h.qty_net face_local
               , h.total_market_value_local fair_value_local
               , h.total_market_value_base fair_value_cad
               , h.total_market_value_base total_exposure
              , /*DAY2*/ null ytm
              , /*DAY2*/ null ytw
              , /*DAY2*/ null stw
              , /*DAY2*/ null rates_duration
              , /*DAY2*/ null ir01
              , /*DAY2*/ null ir01_cad
              , /*DAY2*/ null credit_duration
              , /*DAY2*/ null cs01
              , /*DAY2*/ null cs01_cad
               , h.price gl_price
              , s.industry_vertical alf_sector
               ,h.model_portfolio_id model_portfolio
              , /*DAY2*/ null ci_sector
              , s.scd_id scd_id
              , /*TBC*/ 0 libor_floor
               , s.cppib_security_id cpp_secid
               , h.effective_accrued_interest_rate all_in_cpn 
               , i.gics_industry_group industry_group
               , s.isin isin
               , 'SENTRY' analytics_source
               , h.market_value_net_base carry
               , h.qty_net * h.fx_rate_to_account face_cad
               , s.bloomberg_global_id bloombergcode
               , s.ir_rating rawRating
              , t.translation warf
              , ttt.translation region_alt1     
              , concat(ttt.translation,'|',s.ir_rating) credit_char
              , null trade_id
              , null as murex_strategy_code
              , h.fx_rate_to_account fx_rate
              , 'SENTRY' source_system 
              , h.security_identifier source_system_id
              , now() extract_date
   FROM
     holdings_qa.ci_sentry_holdings h
     left join reference_qa.ci_sentry_security s on h.security_identifier = s.security_identifier and h.business_date between s.start_date and s.end_date
     left join reference.ci_sentry_issuer i on s.issuer_identifier = i.issuer_identifier and h.business_date between i.start_date and i.end_date
     left join reference.reference_country_codes c on upper(i.country_of_exposure)=upper(c.country_name) and c.business_date between date(i.start_date) and date(i.end_date)
     left join (Select
                business_date,security_identifier,sentry_security_type,loan_contract_identifier,colc_fixed_rate,colc_fixed_floating,colc_spread,colc_index_name,facility_maturity_date,
                ROW_NUMBER()  OVER( Partition by (business_date, security_identifier) order by security_identifier,loan_contract_identifier desc ) AS row
               From 
                reference_qa.ci_sentry_security_coupon 
               Where
                loan_contract_status = 'Active') loan_coup ON h.security_identifier = loan_coup.security_identifier 
                                                              and loan_coup.business_date = h.business_date 
                                                              and loan_coup.row = 1
     Left Join reference_qa.ci_sentry_security_coupon bond_coup ON h.security_identifier = bond_coup.security_identifier 
                                                                    and bond_coup.business_date = h.business_date
                                                                    and loan_coup.sentry_security_type NOT IN ('termLoanFacility','delayedDrawLoanFacility','revolvingCreditFacility')
     Left join (select phrase, translation from reference_qa.ci_sentry_translation_groups     
            where business_date = (select max(business_date) as business_date from reference_qa.ci_sentry_translation_groups)
            and group_name = 'SDFE_WARF_Mapping') t ON upper(s.ir_rating)=upper(t.phrase) 
    Left join (select phrase, translation from reference_qa.ci_sentry_translation_groups     
            where business_date = (select max(business_date) as business_date from reference_qa.ci_sentry_translation_groups)
            and group_name = 'SDFE_Raw_Rating_Mapping') tt ON upper(s.ir_rating)=upper(tt.phrase) 
    Left join (select phrase, translation from reference_qa.ci_sentry_translation_groups     
            where business_date = (select max(business_date) as business_date from reference_qa.ci_sentry_translation_groups)
            and group_name = 'SDFE_CO_Region_Alt1_Mapping') ttt ON upper(c.country_code)=upper(ttt.phrase)
WHERE 
		h.business_date >= date_format(date_add('day',-7,date('2025-06-02')),'%Y-%m-%d')
		and h.business_date <= date_format(date('2025-06-02'),'%Y-%m-%d')
            
             
Order by               
      s.inv_group
    , s.inv_strategy
    , s.inv_sub_strategy
    , s.scd_id

group by

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 02
		AND hour between 19 and 20
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-02 19:23:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* QuickSight 896d55d2-59c2-4e33-b5fb-8a0ef32a404f */
SELECT "business_date" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.business_date", "node" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.node", "PV" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.PV", "10 Year Volatility" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.10 Year Volatility", "10 Year VaR" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.10 Year VaR", "10 Year Expected Shortfall" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.10 Year Expected Shortfall", "var_pct" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.var_pct", "vol_pct" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.vol_pct", "cvar_pct" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.cvar_pct", "strategy_node" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.strategy_node"
FROM (-- Step 1: Get program-level metrics
WITH program_data AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(business_date AS DATE) AS business_date,
    program AS node,

    -- Base values
    MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END) AS PV,
    MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR' THEN analytic_value END) AS "10 Year Volatility",
    MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' AND confidence_level = 0.95 THEN analytic_value END) AS "10 Year VaR",
    MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR' AND confidence_level = 0.95 THEN analytic_value END) AS "10 Year Expected Shortfall",

    -- % Calculations (with null and zero checks)
    CASE 
      WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END) != 0 
           AND MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END) IS NOT NULL
      THEN MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' AND confidence_level = 0.95 THEN analytic_value END) 
           / MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS var_pct,

    CASE 
      WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END) != 0 
           AND MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END) IS NOT NULL
      THEN MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR' THEN analytic_value END) 
           / MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS vol_pct,

    CASE 
      WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END) != 0 
           AND MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END) IS NOT NULL
      THEN MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR' AND confidence_level = 0.95 THEN analytic_value END) 
           / MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS cvar_pct

  FROM risk_prod.rmv_analytics
  WHERE program IN ('Listed Real Estate', 'Listed Infrastructure', 'Listed SEG')
    AND hierarchy_level = 'PROGRAM'
    AND portfolio_type = 'IP'
    AND hierarchy_type = 'RISK'
    AND (
          analytic_type IN ('PV', 'VOLATILITY_10YR')
          OR (
             analytic_type IN ('VAR_10YR', 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR')
             AND confidence_level = 0.95
          )
        )
    AND date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE '2023-06-30'
  GROUP BY CAST(business_date AS DATE), program
)

-- Step 2: Add strategy_node manually
SELECT 
  pd.*,
  CASE
    WHEN pd.node = 'Listed Real Estate' THEN 'Real Estate'
    WHEN pd.node = 'Listed Infrastructure' THEN 'Infrastructure'
    WHEN pd.node = 'Listed SEG' THEN 'Sustainable Energy Group'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS strategy_node
FROM program_data pd) AS "LRA- Radar Analytics"

/* cppi::cb5ebf76ac28708e93e88935b1fea3b2ce65a88fc87be3919d5f9f5909745ee8 */
WITH analytic_pv AS
    (select sd.business_date, analytic_value
     from radar_reporting_prod
    .fact_analytic_sd sd
    join radar_reporting_prod.dim_hierarchy_node dh
on sd.dim_hierarchy_node_id = dh.dim_hierarchy_node_id and dh.node_level=2 and dh.node_name ='ACPP' and sd.business_date = dh.business_date

where analytic_type = 'PV'
  and portfolio_type = 'TOTAL_FUND_BY_ACCOUNT'
  and sd.business_date = '2025-05-30'
    )
select ule.party_name,
       ule.gics_sector,
       sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure)                                 as credit_exposure,
       pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * ule.acpp_single_name_board_limit as single_name_limit,
       case
           when ule.acpp_single_name_board_limit > 0 then round(sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure) /
                                                                (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * ule.acpp_single_name_board_limit) *
                                                                100, 1)
           else 0 end as usage,
    CASE
        WHEN sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure) / (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * ule.acpp_single_name_board_limit) BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.949999999
            THEN 'Yellow Alert'
        WHEN sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure) / (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * ule.acpp_single_name_board_limit) BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.999999999
            THEN 'Orange Alert'
        WHEN sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure) >= (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * ule.acpp_single_name_board_limit)
            THEN 'Breach'
        ELSE 'OK'
END
AS status

from radar_reporting_prod.fact_cr_exposure f
         join radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity le on f.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = le.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id and f.business_date = le.business_date
		 join radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity ule on le.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = ule.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id and ule.acpp_single_name_board_limit is not null and ule.acpp_single_name_board_limit != -1 and f.business_date = ule.business_date

         left join analytic_pv pv on f.business_date = pv.business_date

group by ule.party_name, ule.gics_sector, ule.acpp_single_name_board_limit, pv.analytic_value
order by sum(acpp_credit_exposure) desc

WITH analytic_pv AS
    (select sd.business_date, analytic_value
     from radar_reporting_prod
    .fact_analytic_sd sd
    join radar_reporting_prod.dim_hierarchy_node dh
on sd.dim_hierarchy_node_id = dh.dim_hierarchy_node_id and dh.node_level=2 and dh.node_name ='ACPP' and sd.business_date = dh.business_date

where analytic_type = 'PV'
  and portfolio_type = 'TOTAL_FUND_BY_ACCOUNT'
  and sd.business_date = '2025-05-30'
    )
select ule.party_name,
       ule.gics_sector,
       sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure)                                 as credit_exposure,
       pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * ule.acpp_single_name_board_limit as single_name_limit,
       case
           when ule.acpp_single_name_board_limit > 0 then round(sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure) /
                                                                (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * ule.acpp_single_name_board_limit) *
                                                                100, 1)
           else 0 end as usage,
    CASE
        WHEN sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure) / (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * ule.acpp_single_name_board_limit) BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.949999999
            THEN 'Yellow Alert'
        WHEN sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure) / (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * ule.acpp_single_name_board_limit) BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.999999999

        WHEN sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure) >= (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * ule.acpp_single_name_board_limit)

	                AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id

	    GROUP BY

	      child.cppib_party_id,

	      coalesce( country.name, child.domicile_country_code ),

	      INNER JOIN radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent
		    ON child.business_date = parent.business_date and child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	      INNER JOIN radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos
		    ON fact.business_date = pos.business_date and fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
			AND UPPER( pos.PRODUCT_TYPE ) <> 'NETTING'
	    WHERE
	        (
	          parent.is_fi = 'Y'
	          OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
	          OR EXISTS
	            (
	              SELECT 1
	              FROM radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
	              WHERE
					parent.business_date = sibling.business_date
	                and sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
	             )
	        )
	      AND (
			EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
			OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
		  )
          AND child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id != child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
		GROUP BY
	      child.cppib_party_id,
	      child.party_name,
	      child.rtg_final
	  ),
	  child_level_exp_limits AS
	    (
	      SELECT
	        parent.cppib_party_id AS cppib_party_id_parent,
	        child.cppib_party_id AS cppib_party_id_child,
	        SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.st_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS st_exposure,
	        MAX( child.st_cash_pb_fi_limit ) AS st_smd_threshold,
	        SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.mt_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS mt_exposure,
	        MAX( child.mt_cash_pb_fi_limit ) AS mt_smd_threshold,

	      WHERE
	        fact.business_date = '2025-05-30'

	        AND child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	        AND fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
	        AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) <> 'NETTING'
	        AND
	          (
	            parent.is_fi = 'Y'
	            OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
	            OR EXISTS
	              (
	                SELECT 1
	                FROM radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
	                WHERE
	                  parent.business_date = sibling.business_date
					  and sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                  AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                  AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
	               )
	          )
			AND (
				EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
				OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
			  )
            AND child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id != child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	      GROUP BY
	        parent.cppib_party_id,
	        child.cppib_party_id
	    ),
	  breaches_under_parents AS
	    (
			SELECT
            	cppib_party_id_parent AS cppib_party_id,
            	MIN
				  (
	                CASE
                        WHEN st_exposure / st_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
                            OR mt_exposure / mt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
                            OR lt_exposure / lt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
                            THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                        WHEN st_exposure / st_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
                            OR mt_exposure / mt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
                            OR lt_exposure / lt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
                            THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
	                    WHEN st_exposure >= st_smd_threshold OR mt_exposure >= mt_smd_threshold OR lt_exposure >= lt_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
	                    ELSE 'OK'
	                END
	              ) AS status
            FROM child_level_exp_limits
            GROUP BY
            	cppib_party_id_parent
    	)
	SELECT
	  'Y' AS has_children,
	  c.party_name,
	  CASE
          WHEN SUM(st_exposure) / st_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
              OR SUM(mt_exposure) / mt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
              OR SUM(lt_exposure) / lt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
              THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
          WHEN SUM(st_exposure) / st_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
              OR SUM(mt_exposure) / mt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
              OR SUM(lt_exposure) / lt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
              THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
	      WHEN SUM( st_exposure ) >= st_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
	      WHEN SUM( mt_exposure ) >= mt_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
	      WHEN SUM( lt_exposure ) >= lt_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
		  ELSE coalesce( MIN( b.status ), 'OK' )
	  END AS status,
	  CASE
	    WHEN country_code = 'United States' THEN 'US'
		WHEN country_code = 'United Kingdom' THEN 'UK'
		ELSE country_code
	  END AS country_code,
	  coalesce( rtg_final, '-' ) AS rtg_final,
	  coalesce( rtg_outlook, '-' ) AS rtg_outlook,

	  SUM( st_exposure ) / 1000000 AS st_exposure,
	  coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate( ( SUM( st_exposure ) - SUM( prev_st_exposure ) ) / 1000000)), '-' )  AS st_change_exposure,
      coalesce(st_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS st_smd_threshold,
      REPLACE(coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate(st_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(st_exposure)) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS st_available,
      CASE
          WHEN st_smd_threshold = 0 OR st_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
          ELSE GREATEST( 0, SUM( st_exposure ) ) / st_smd_threshold * 100
      END AS st_utilization,

	  SUM( mt_exposure ) / 1000000 AS mt_exposure,
	  coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate((SUM( mt_exposure ) - SUM( prev_mt_exposure ) ) / 1000000)), '-' )  AS mt_change_exposure,
      coalesce(mt_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS mt_smd_threshold,
      REPLACE(coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate((mt_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(mt_exposure))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS mt_available,
      CASE
          WHEN mt_smd_threshold = 0 OR mt_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
          ELSE GREATEST( 0, SUM( mt_exposure ) ) / mt_smd_threshold * 100
      END AS mt_utilization,

	  SUM( lt_exposure ) / 1000000 AS lt_exposure,
	  coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate( ( SUM( lt_exposure ) - SUM( prev_lt_exposure ) ) / 1000000)), '-' )  AS lt_change_exposure,
      coalesce(lt_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS lt_smd_threshold,
      REPLACE(coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate((lt_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(lt_exposure))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS lt_available,
      CASE
          WHEN lt_smd_threshold = 0 OR lt_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
          ELSE GREATEST( 0, SUM( lt_exposure ) ) / lt_smd_threshold * 100
      END AS lt_utilization,

	  MAX( p.prev_rtg_final ) AS prev_rtg_final,
	  dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	  ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	  CASE WHEN SUM( st_exposure ) >= st_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS st_limit_blown,
	  CASE WHEN SUM( mt_exposure ) >= mt_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS mt_limit_blown,
	  CASE WHEN SUM( lt_exposure ) >= lt_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS lt_limit_blown
	FROM current_exposure c

	LEFT JOIN breaches_under_parents b ON c.cppib_party_id = b.cppib_party_id AND 'child' = 'parent'
	LEFT JOIN prev_exposure p
	  ON c.cppib_party_id = p.cppib_party_id
	  OR c.party_name = p.party_name
	GROUP BY
        st_smd_threshold,
        mt_smd_threshold,
        lt_smd_threshold,
	  dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	  ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	  c.party_name,
	  country_code,
	  rtg_final,
	  rtg_outlook
    ORDER BY
		CASE
            WHEN status = 'YELLOW ALERT' THEN 1
            WHEN status = 'ORANGE ALERT' THEN 2
            WHEN status = 'EXCESS' THEN 3
            ELSE 4
		END,
		ST_EXPOSURE DESC,
		party_name ASC

      REPLACE(coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate((mt_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(mt_exposure))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS mt_available,
      CASE
          WHEN mt_smd_threshold = 0 OR mt_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
          ELSE GREATEST( 0, SUM( mt_exposure ) ) / mt_smd_threshold * 100
      END AS mt_utilization,

	  SUM( lt_exposure ) / 1000000 AS lt_exposure,
	  coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate( ( SUM( lt_exposure ) - SUM( prev_lt_exposure ) ) / 1000000)), '-' )  AS lt_change_exposure,
      coalesce(lt_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS lt_smd_threshold,
      REPLACE(coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate((lt_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(lt_exposure))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS lt_available,
      CASE
          WHEN lt_smd_threshold = 0 OR lt_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
          ELSE GREATEST( 0, SUM( lt_exposure ) ) / lt_smd_threshold * 100
      END AS lt_utilization,

	  MAX( p.prev_rtg_final ) AS prev_rtg_final,
	  dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	  ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	  CASE WHEN SUM( st_exposure ) >= st_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS st_limit_blown,
	  CASE WHEN SUM( mt_exposure ) >= mt_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS mt_limit_blown,
	  CASE WHEN SUM( lt_exposure ) >= lt_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS lt_limit_blown
	FROM current_exposure c

	LEFT JOIN breaches_under_parents b ON c.cppib_party_id = b.cppib_party_id AND 'child' = 'parent'
	LEFT JOIN prev_exposure p
	  ON c.cppib_party_id = p.cppib_party_id
	  OR c.party_name = p.party_name
	GROUP BY
        st_smd_threshold,
        mt_smd_threshold,
        lt_smd_threshold,
	  dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	  ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	  c.party_name,
	  country_code,
	  rtg_final,
	  rtg_outlook
    ORDER BY
		CASE
            WHEN status = 'YELLOW ALERT' THEN 1
            WHEN status = 'ORANGE ALERT' THEN 2
            WHEN status = 'EXCESS' THEN 3
            ELSE 4
		END,
		ST_EXPOSURE DESC,
		party_name ASC

			join risk_dev.dim_inst i on i.cppib_security_id = class.id_holding_decomposition and i.business_date = cast(class.business_date as varchar) 
			where i.business_date = '2025-05-30' and class.holding_decomposition_id_type_code = 'CPPIBSEC_ID')

				when dpi.portfolio_type = 'INDEX_LOOKTHROUGH' then replace(dpi.pos_source_system_key, 'CPPSECID')
				when dpi.portfolio_type = 'LOOKTHROUGH' and position('OFFSET' in dpi.pos_source_system_key) > 0 then dpi.pos_source_system_key
				else concat(substr(dpi.pos_source_system_key, 1, position('_' in dpi.pos_source_system_key)-1), '_', dpi.pos_short_desc)
			end 
		) as "position_key",
		dpi.portfolio_type,
		c.abacus_notional_base_ccy,
        c.abacus_notional_local_ccy,
        c.abacus_pv_base_ccy,

        dpi.long_short,

                when l1_rle.cppib_party_id is not null then l1_rle.cppib_party_id
                when mi_rle.cppib_party_id is not null then mi_rle.cppib_party_id
                else null
            end
        ) as issuer_cppib_party_id,
        (
            case 
                when i_rle.party_name is not null then i_rle.party_name
                when l1_rle.party_name is not null then l1_rle.party_name
                when mi_rle.party_name is not null then mi_rle.party_name

            end

        (

                when l1_rle.gics_sector is not null then l1_rle.gics_sector 
                when cl.industry_sector_name is not null then cl.industry_sector_name
                when mi_rle.gics_sector is not null then mi_rle.gics_sector
                else null
            end
        ) as issuer_gics_sector,
        (
            case 
                when i_rle.gics_industry_group is not null then i_rle.gics_industry_group
                when l1_rle.gics_industry_group is not null then l1_rle.gics_industry_group

                when mi_rle.gics_industry_group is not null then mi_rle.gics_industry_group

select count(*) from (SELECT h.model_portfolio_id AS MPDEFS_MP,
 h.abor_security_id AS SECURITIES_SECSHORT,
 MAX(CASE WHEN h.balance_nominal_number >= 0 THEN h.balance_nominal_number END) AS PFCHOLDINGS_BALNOMVALP,
 MAX(CASE WHEN h.balance_nominal_number < 0 THEN -1 * h.balance_nominal_number END) AS PFCHOLDINGS_BALNOMVALS,
 t.party_name AS PARTNERS_BROKERNAME,
 t.trade_date AS SECURITIES_ISSDATE,
 h.abor_maturity_date AS PFCKEYRATIOS_MATDATE,
 h.portfolio_id AS PORTFOLIOS_POR,
 MAX(CASE WHEN h.balance_nominal_number >= 0 THEN h.quotation_currency_code ELSE NULL END) AS HOLKEYS_QUOCURP,

 h.portfolio_group_name AS PORTGROUPS_PORGRP

 JOIN (
 select DISTINCT t.abor_security_id , t.trade_date, p.party_name
 from trades_deals.scd_transactions t
 join reference.scd_party_issuer p on  t.counterparty_id = p.scd_party_id

 and h.security_group_id in ('FXFORWARD', 'FXNDF')
 and h.balance_nominal_number != 0
 GROUP BY
 h.model_portfolio_id,
 h.abor_security_id,
 t.party_name,

            COALESCE(iss_country.country_name, ' ') as issuerctyname,

            COALESCE(trade_country.country_name, ' ') as tradectyname,
            CASE
                WHEN hold.balance_nominal_number = CAST(hold.balance_nominal_number AS BIGINT)
                    THEN CAST(CAST(hold.balance_nominal_number AS BIGINT) as VARCHAR)
                ELSE TRIM(TRAILING '0' FROM CAST(CAST(FLOOR(hold.balance_nominal_number * POWER(10, 9)) / POWER(10, 9) AS DECIMAL(38, 9)) AS VARCHAR))
                END AS balnomval,
            CASE
                WHEN hold.clean_price = CAST(hold.clean_price AS INT)
                    THEN CAST(CAST(hold.clean_price AS INT) AS VARCHAR)
                ELSE TRIM(TRAILING '0' FROM CAST(CAST(FLOOR(hold.clean_price * POWER(10, 9)) / POWER(10, 9) AS DECIMAL(38, 9)) AS VARCHAR))
                END AS cleanqc,
            COALESCE(CONCAT(hold.abor_maturity_date, 'T00:00:00.000-0400'), '') as matdate,
            COALESCE(hold.abor_maturity_date, '') as matdate_caroni,
            COALESCE(CONCAT(hold.business_date, 'T00:00:00.000-0400'), '') as todate,
            COALESCE(hold.business_date, '') as todate_caroni,
            COALESCE(hold.abor_security_number, '') as security_no,
            ' ' as murex_port_code,
            COALESCE(und.sedol_id, '') as sedol_underly,
            COALESCE(und.isin_id, '') as isin_underly,
            COALESCE(und.bloomberg_unique_id, '') as bb_underly,
            CASE
                WHEN hold.clean_price * hold.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency = CAST(hold.clean_price * hold.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS INT)
                    THEN CAST(CAST(hold.clean_price * hold.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS INT) as VARCHAR)
                ELSE TRIM(TRAILING '0' FROM CAST(CAST(FLOOR(hold.clean_price * hold.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency
                    * POWER(10, 9)) / POWER(10, 9) AS DECIMAL(38, 9)) AS VARCHAR))
                END AS cleanpc,
            COALESCE(CONCAT(esc.esm_issue_date, 'T00:00:00.000-0400'), '') as issue_date,
            COALESCE(esc.esm_issue_date, '') as issue_date_caroni,
            COALESCE(CAST(cast(repo.repo_nominal as BIGINT) as VARCHAR), '0') as repo_nominal,

                 join final_dates fd on hold.business_date = fd.business_date
                 left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite esc on hold.business_date = date_format(esc.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')
            and hold.cppib_sec_id = cast(esc.cppib_sec_id as varchar)
                 left join holdings.repo_holdings_details repo on hold.business_date = date_format(repo.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') and hold.scd_holding_key_id = repo.id_source_holding

                 left join asset.asset_security_identifiers asi on hold.business_date = date_format(asi.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')
            and hold.cppib_sec_id = cast(asi.cppib_sec_id as varchar)
                 left join party.party party on cast(party.cppib_party_id as varchar) = esc.cppib_party_id and date_format(party.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = hold.business_date
                 left join (select id_cppib_party, max(party_group) as party_group
                            from reference.scd_party_issuer iss
                                     join final_dates fd on iss.business_date = fd.business_date
                            group by id_cppib_party) iss
                           on iss.id_cppib_party = cast(party.cppib_party_id as varchar)
                 left join reference.reference_country_codes iss_country on iss_country.country_code = party.domicile_country_code
            and iss_country.business_date = party.business_date
                 left join reference.reference_country_codes trade_country on trade_country.country_code = esc.esm_country_code
            and date_format(trade_country.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = hold.business_date
                 left join reference.reference_currency_codes port_curr on date_format(port_curr.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = hold.business_date
            and port_curr.currency_code = port.portfolio_currency
                 left join reference.reference_currency_codes local_curr on date_format(local_curr.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = hold.business_date
            and local_curr.currency_code = hold.quotation_currency_code
                 left join reference.scd_securities sec on sec.abor_security_number = hold.abor_security_number and sec.business_date = hold.business_date
                 left join reference.scd_securities und on sec.abor_underlying_instrument_id = und.scd_security_key_id and sec.business_date = und.business_date
                 left join
             (select exchange_id, max(exchange_name) as exchange_name
              from (select mic as exchange_id, max(mic_name) as exchange_name from reference.reference_exchange_codes exc where
                  date_format(exc.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = '2025-05-06' group by mic

              group by exchange_id
             ) as exc2
             on exc2.exchange_id = sec.abor_exchange_id
        where (hold.balance_nominal_number != 0 or
                hold.balance_nominal_number_unsettled != 0 or

WITH base_data AS (
    SELECT

        CASE
            WHEN month(date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (4,5,6)
                THEN cast(year(date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) + 1 AS varchar) || 'Q1'
            WHEN month(date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (7,8,9)
                THEN cast(year(date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) + 1 AS varchar) || 'Q2'
            WHEN month(date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (10,11,12)
                THEN cast(year(date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) + 1 AS varchar) || 'Q3'
            ELSE cast(year(date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) AS varchar) || 'Q4'
        END AS fiscal_quarter_key
    FROM risk_prod.rmv_analytics r
    WHERE r.portfolio_type = 'IP'
      AND r.hierarchy_type = 'RISK'
      AND r.hierarchy_level IN ('DEPARTMENT', 'STRATEGY', 'PROGRAM')
      AND (
            r.analytic_type IN ('PV', 'VOLATILITY_10YR')
            OR (
                r.analytic_type IN ('VAR_10YR', 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR')
                AND r.confidence_level = 0.95
            )
        )
      AND date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') >= date '2020-04-01'
),

quarter_end_dates AS (
    SELECT fiscal_quarter_key, MAX(parsed_date) AS quarter_end_date
    FROM base_data
    WHERE month(parsed_date) IN (3, 6, 9, 12)
    GROUP BY fiscal_quarter_key
),

core_pool AS (
    SELECT 
        date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS parsed_date,
        SUM(market_value_qc) AS core_pool_aum
    FROM risk_prod.ref_fund_unitization
    WHERE fund_code = 'CORE'
    GROUP BY date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')
),

filtered AS (
    SELECT 
        d.*,
        CASE 
            WHEN d.parsed_date = q.quarter_end_date THEN 
                'F' || substr(d.fiscal_quarter_key, 3, 2) || ' ' || substr(d.fiscal_quarter_key, 5, 2)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS fiscal_quarter,
        cp.core_pool_aum
    FROM base_data d
    LEFT JOIN quarter_end_dates q 
        ON d.fiscal_quarter_key = q.fiscal_quarter_key AND d.parsed_date = q.quarter_end_date
    LEFT JOIN core_pool cp

                                aa.option_symbol,
                                aa.strike_price/1000.0 as strike,
                                aa.expiration_date,
                                aa.open_interest,
                                aa.call_put_flag,
                                aa.best_bid,
                                aa.best_ask,
                                aa.vega, 
                                bb.close_price as SpotRef, 
                                aa.strike_price/1000.0/bb.close_price as Mny
                                from market.om_option_price aa
                                join market.om_security_price bb
                        on
                            bb.security_id=aa.security_id and bb.business_date = aa.business_date
                        where
                            aa.security_id = 213084
                            AND aa.business_date >= DATE '2025-05-30'
                            AND aa.business_date <= DATE '2025-05-30'
                            AND date_diff('day', aa.business_date, aa.expiration_date) > 5
                            AND aa.best_bid > 0
                            AND aa.best_ask > 0
                            AND aa.special_settlement_flag <> '1'
                            AND (
                                (aa.best_bid + aa.best_ask) / 2 >= CASE 
                                    WHEN aa.call_put_flag = 'C' THEN GREATEST(bb.close_price - aa.strike_price / 1000.0, 0)
                                    WHEN aa.call_put_flag = 'P' THEN GREATEST(aa.strike_price / 1000.0 - bb.close_price, 0)
                                END
                            )
                        ORDER BY 
                            business_date, expiration_date, call_put_flag, strike ASC

		    and fx.rate_type = 'CROSS'
		    and dv01.business_date = fx.business_date
		    where dv01.calc_type = 'DV01'
		    and dv01.business_date = '2025-05-15'
		    and crv.curve_type_value = 'ZERO'
		    group by pos_id),
cs01 as (select pos_id, 
            sum(coalesce((1 / fx.mid_val), 1) * cs01.final_value) AS cs01_cad
			from risk_prod.fact_pos_calc_md cs01

		    and cs01.business_date = '2025-05-15'
		    group by pos_id),
pos_var95 as (select pos_id, var_10yr, var_12yr, var_5yr, confidence_level

				when dpi.portfolio_type = 'LOOKTHROUGH' and position('OFFSET' in dpi.pos_source_system_key) > 0 then dpi.pos_source_system_key
				else concat(substr(dpi.pos_source_system_key, 1, position('_' in dpi.pos_source_system_key)-1), '_', dpi.pos_short_desc)

		) as "position_key",

                when mi_rle.cppib_party_id is not null then mi_rle.cppib_party_id

        (
            case 
                when i_rle.party_name is not null then i_rle.party_name
                when l1_rle.party_name is not null then l1_rle.party_name
                when mi_rle.party_name is not null then mi_rle.party_name

        ) as issuer_party_name,

                when l1_rle.gics_sector is not null then l1_rle.gics_sector

            end
        ) as issuer_party_name,

            case

                when l1_rle.gics_sector is not null then l1_rle.gics_sector 
                when mi_rle.gics_sector is not null then mi_rle.gics_sector

            end
        ) as issuer_gics_sector,
        (
            case

                when l1_rle.secm_exposure_country is not null then l1_rle.secm_exposure_country

            end
        ) as issuer_country_of_exposure,
        (
            case

        (
            case

            end
        ) as isin,
        (
            case 
                when dpi.sedol is not null then dpi.sedol 
                when inst1.sedol is not null then inst1.sedol

            end
        ) as sedol,
